name: Bitdefender
summary: GravityZone endpoint protection for small business, managed from one console. Add-ons and setup are priced separately.
best_for: small businesses that want top-tier, independently-validated endpoint protection managed from one console
skip_if: you're a solo user with basic needs — built-in OS defenses plus good habits may be enough before you pay for a business console
honest_knock: The price you see is already discounted: the configurator applies 30% off list by default on all three GravityZone tiers, so compare on the discounted figure and ask what applies at renewal rather than assuming the same 30% comes back. Add-ons are billed separately too — web access and device control, network attack defense and risk management, and setup each carry their own line. Protection scores are consistently strong, so the real trade-off is cost, not efficacy.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a year per device (list price at 10 devices for one year)
pricing.notes: Read on their own product pages, 6 September 2026 and again, unchanged, 25 September 2026, where a configurator prices each tier by device count and term. At 10 devices for one year the list prices are GravityZone Small Business Security $324.99, Business Security $384.99 and Business Security Premium $879.99 — $32.50, $38.50 and $88.00 per device per year. A 30% discount is applied by default on all three, bringing them to $227.49, $269.49 and $615.99. Small Business Security at 5 devices for one year is $169.99 list, $118.99 discounted. Add-ons are priced separately: at 10 devices, Web Access and Device Control $41.99 and Network Attack Defense and Risk Management $41.99 on Small Business Security, Setup & Go $224.99, and Essential: Tips & Best Practices $54.99 a seat. Enterprise Security, Defense XDR and MDR are contact-sales.
